issue.title: #21 canonical() refuses Linux-legal names that look like drive paths
issue.body: canonical() in bench/protected.ts refuses Linux-legal names such as `a:b.md` and `c:notes.md` and fails the whole PR. Refuse real drive paths (`C:/x`, `C:\\x`) and accept these names, with tests.

issue.title: #14 repo-id edges: double slash and bracketed IPv6
issue.body: Repo ids from remotes are wrong at two edges: `https://github.com//org//repo` keeps the double slash, and `git@[::1]:org/repo` is mangled. Make repoIdFrom return one clean id for each, with tests.
